In addressing a person from a distance the tone is called एकश्रुति or monotony.

Terms: एकश्रुति

A word which hs one fixed case, (while the word compounded with it may vary its case) is also उपसर्जन , except for the purposes of the the rule which requires the उपसर्जन to stand first in a compound.

Terms: उपसर्जन

In the case of Vocative, the singular number of the 1st case-affix is called स्मबुद्धि।

Terms: विभक्ति-8

The affix ख comes in the sense of 'what bears it' after the word एकधुरा being in Accusative -2nd case construction, the affix is optionally elided too.

Terms: ख

The affix ठञ् always comes in the sense of मतुप् after a stem which in composition is preceded by एक or गो।

Terms: ठञ्

After the word एक the substitute comes optionally instead of धा।

Terms: ध्यमुञ् (ध्यम्)

After the word एक comes also the affix आकिनिच् (आकिन्) (the word retaining its denotation) when the sense is 'without a companion'.

Terms: आकिनिच् (आकिन्)

After the word एक , according to the opinion of Eastern Grammarians, may be added the affixes डतरच् and डतमच् in the above senses.

Terms: डतरच् and डतमच्

The affix ठच् also comes optionally after the word एकशाला with the force of 'like this'.

Terms: ठच्

The word सकृत् is substituted for एक before the affix सुच् (स्) when an action is to be counted.

Terms: सुच् (स्)

In the room of the first portion, containing a single vowel, there are two.

Terms:
From here up to

inclusive is always to be supplied the phrase 'for the preceding and the following is substituted'.

Terms: संहितायाम्

उद is optionally substituted for उदक before a word beginning with a single consonant and which expresses that which is filled with water.

Terms: Some Substitution

The short is substituted for the long एका before a तद्धित affix and when a second member follows.

Terms: Some Substitution

The Negative Particle remains unchanged in a word which begins with एक and of this एक there is the augment अदुक् (अद्)।

Terms: नुट् Augment

This substitution of अत् is made in the singular number also in the Ablative -5th case after the अङ्ग (stems) युष्मद् and अस्मद्।

Terms: Some substitution

The augment इट् is not added to that affix which is joined to a root which is joined to a root, which in the Grammatical system of Instruction (i.e. in the धातुपाठ) is one syllable and is without accent (अनुदात्त).

Terms: इट् augment

When एक is repeated, it is treated like a member of a बहुव्रीहि समास ।

Terms: Doubling of Words

Also in connection with एक and अन्य , optionally in the छन्दस् (Vedas), the first verb retains its accent, when these word have the same meaning ('the one - the other').

Terms: Accent

The single substitute of an unaccented with an उदात्त (acute accent) vowel is उदात्त।

Terms: Accent

For the letters 1. ब 2. ग 3. ड or 4. द in the beginning of a mono-syllable and belonging to a root, and which ends in 1. झ 2. भ 3. घ 4. ढ or 5. ध there is substituted 1. भ 2. घ 3. ढ or 4. ध respectively before स् or ध्व or at the end of a word.

Terms: Some substitution

In a compound, the second member of which is a monosyllable, there is ण in the room of न of the second member, provided that the न is at the end of a प्रातिपदिक , or is the augment नुम् , or occurs in a विभक्ति; and when the first member contains a cause of change.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-आगमन-विभक्ति
